## ***Dynamic Typing vs Static Typing***
 
*   Dynamic Typing means that python knows the data type of variable by looking at the value we donot have to tell whether data is int ot string
```
 a = 5
```

*  Static Typing means that we have to tell the compiler the data type of variable by writing the data type before the variable

```
 int a = 5
```

## ***Static Binding vs Dynamic Binding***


*   Dynamic binding means that one variable can have multiple data types

```
 a = 5
 print(a)
 a = 'abc'
 print(a)
```


*  Static binding means that one variable can have only single data type throughout the program it cannot get another data type


```
 int a = 5
```
